messages.text:
I can’t send the refund to your sister’s bank account. Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, so your request to use another account can’t be fulfilled. [refund-policy/v2/payment]

I’ve created a proposal for **BRL 149.65** for the returned speaker. If you want the refund to go to the original payment, confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a chat reply won’t confirm it. [refund-policy/v2/amount] [refund-policy/v2/approval]
